author: 3owj
content: Extended DEADLINE_RE in extract.rs with 5 new pattern groups: \bturn\s+in\b, \bhand\s+in\b, \boverdue\b, full month names via jan(?:uary)? etc., ordinal dates via \d{1,2}(?:st|nd|rd|th), and tomorrow/tonight after 'by'. Switched regex to (?ix) verbose mode for readability. Added 10 new tests covering each new case plus a no-false-positive for bare 'tomorrow'. 247 tests pass, no warnings. Closes L30 / L55.
